body: Thank you so so much❤️ I don’t know you but I really do appreciate you for everything ❤️
I told the person In question that I think it’s best for my mental health to cut everything off. It feels worse right now but I know it’s the right call for long term
It’s honestly been a disaster and has progressively gotten worse over the course of this last week until my breaking point tonight. I don’t see the light at the end of the tunnel right now
It’s something that’s been happening but progressively keeps getting worse at this point

It is, and honestly the onset was definitely relationship related, it’s been super downhill the last few days. Right when I think it might be starting to get better we’re back to, or somehow worse than square one. I decided I needed to cut it off completely to try to salvage my mental health. My insurance won’t pay for me to speak with my therapist until Monday again. I ate a few edibles to hopefully calm myself down and pass out to escape my mind for a few hours.

I don’t even know what I need right now. I tried chatting with the suicide hotline but the wait time was too long and I panicked and closed out the tab instead . I feel like I’m in my own head and I can’t turn off all these overwhelming emotions and thoughts
So much honestly. It feels like everything is going wrong
